data.long_meaning: Meehan is a name of Irish origin meaning 'Small, Dear'. It is a unisex name and can be used for both boys and girls. The name has a rich history and is believed to be derived from the Old Irish word 'meic Aodhain' which translates to 'son of Aodhain'. Aodhain is a name of Celtic origin and is believed to mean 'little fire'. The name Meehan carries the essence of the Old Irish word and signifies someone who is small in stature but has a big heart. It is a name that is full of wisdom, strength, and courage.
